## Checklist

For each item, please check it off if completed, mark it as N/A if it does not apply, or leave it unchecked if it has not been completed yet.

- [ ] Documented what was changed and why
- [ ] Added or updated in-code documentation where needed
- [ ] Added or updated tests for new or modified functionality
- [ ] Performed regression, i.e. verified that existing tests still pass
- [ ] Re-used existing modules, utilities, and patterns where applicable
- [ ] Followed existing project conventions and architecture
- [ ] Handled relevant edge cases and error conditions
- [ ] Removed unnecessary, obsolete, or temporary code/comments
- [ ] Reviewed the changes for unintended side effects
- [ ] Reviewed the final diff for unnecessary or unrelated changes
